sections.content: You know *por eso* (A2 Unit 5) and *así que* (B1 Unit 1). *Como resultado* and *por esa razón* work in the same way: use them to explain consequences.

items.spanish: Había poco tiempo, por eso salimos temprano.
items.english: There was little time, so we left early.

items.spanish: El precio subió; como resultado, muchas personas cambiaron de plan.
items.english: The price went up; as a result, many people changed their plans.

items.spanish: Faltaba transporte; por esa razón, los comerciantes tuvieron problemas.
items.english: There was a lack of transport; for that reason, the shopkeepers had problems.

sections.content: These connectors point forward from cause to result, the reverse of *porque*: the cause comes first, then *por eso*, *así que* or *como resultado* introduces the result.
